scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions test && npm run test:rules:emulator
scripts.test:rules:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-knb-stats "npm run test:rules"
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-knb-stats --import=./.emulator-data --export-on-exit
scripts.test:smoke: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,hosting,tasks --project demo-knb-stats "node scripts/emulator-smoke.mjs"
